newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico November maquiladora employment up - INEGI.
newsitem.headline: Mexico November maquiladora employment up - INEGI.

text.p: Employment in the maquiladora export industry in November 1996 posted a year-on-year increase of 20.3 percent, Mexico's National Statistics Institute (INEGI) said on Wednesday.
INEGI said 811,376 people were employed in maquiladora plants in November, compared to 674,693 one year earlier.
Employment for the year to November was up 17.2 percent from the same period the year before, INEGI added.
Total value-added from maquiladora exports for November 1996 was 4.699 billion pesos, up from 3.075 billion pesos in November 1995.
